plan.title: Joking tester, bedtime, asks for no emojis midway

transcript.text: hey lol is this the sleep coaching thing? my friend said u guys could help me stop being up till 2am every night 😅

Yep, you found it! I'm ZOH, an AI coach, and I'll help you get off the 2am cycle with one small step a day. You can text "stop" anytime, or tell me to chill out or push harder and I'll adjust. Let's go! What's your name?
Theo lol. so is this gonna be like a robot yelling at me to go to bed
Ha, no yelling, Theo. I'm more the friend who backs you up and keeps you honest, one small step at a time. So what usually keeps you up until 2am?
haha ok fair. honestly mostly my phone in bed. tiktok then youtube and suddenly it's 2am 💀
Classic trap, Theo, and very fixable. What time would you want to be asleep on a normal night?
Haha tiktok at 11pm is a trap, 2am is just the bill lol. Ideally lights out by 11:30 🙃
"2am is just the bill" is going on a poster, Theo. 11:30 is a very doable target. How many hours of sleep do you want to get on a normal night?
Haha honestly probably like 7-8? I'm running on fumes rn 💀
Running on fumes is exactly why 11:30 matters, Theo. Do you use a sleep app or wearable to track your sleep, or is it just you and the clock?
Haha I've got an Apple Watch that tracks sleep, so it'll tell you I'm a disaster lol. Does it sync with this or do I have to do it manually? 🙃

No sync on my end, Theo. You'd send me a screenshot of your watch's sleep data as proof, and that's easy. Nobody's judging the disaster, we're just tracking it moving the right way 😄 Where do you want this to get you? Like waking up less wrecked, or being asleep by 11:30 most nights. "Not sure yet" is totally fine too.
Got it, no emojis from here on. Where do you want this to get you, Theo? Waking up less wrecked, asleep by 11:30 most nights, or "not sure yet" is totally fine too.
haha ok. asleep by 11:30 most nights, that's the goal. "less wrecked" is kinda the vibe too lol. what's the plan tho, do i have to delete tiktok or something 💀

No need to delete TikTok, Theo. The problem is the phone being in your bed, so we move the phone, not the app. Here's the plan:

• Where this gets you: asleep by 11:30 most nights, and less wrecked in the mornings
• Setup today: pick a charging spot across the room, out of arm's reach of the bed
• Tonight: at 11:00 pm the phone goes on that charger, then lights out by 11:30
• Every day at 11:00 pm, same routine, 30 minutes from charger to lights out
• Proof: a screenshot of your Apple Watch sleep data the next morning. If that's a hassle, a photo of the phone on its charger works too
• Why: scrolling happens because the phone is within reach, so putting it across the room breaks the TikTok to YouTube slide

I'll still reach you with a heads-up at 10:50 pm. Each day shapes the next step, so we build toward 11:30 lights out without needing willpower at midnight. What do you think?
